messages:
Maya: Anyone up for a Saturday office LAN? thinking hotseat Smash + Steam library swap + some indie rounds. projector in common room works? :video_game: :popcorn:
Jonah: I'm down. Bringing my Switch + dock. Any chance someone has an HDMI adapter for USB-C? :thinking_face:
Priya: Count me in. I can bring an ethernet switch and extra Cat6. @Sam did you say you have spare cables?
Sam: Yep 8-port switch + a bundle of cables. Might be able to bring my old CRT if someone can pick it up from my place. :truck:
Zoe: I'll put a few Steam games up for swap — Portal 2, Into The Breach, and a bunch of roguelikes. Anyone want Portal 2? :package:
Maya: Portal 2 please! Also who wants to be on snack duty? I can order pizza if folks chip in $5.
Jonah: I'll Venmo $5 to Maya. :+1: pizza
Sam: I can bring chips & salsa. Also 2 extra wired controllers for the TV.
lobby-bot: Office common room booking confirmed for Sat 17:00-23:00. Please tidy up after.
Priya: Quick network note: some older PC games need port forwarding if you host locally. Forward TCP/UDP 27015 to the host. Example for our router:```bash
# on router admin
forward TCP 27015 -> 10.0.5.20
```
Maya: Nice catch. We'll have a small LAN subnet ready and a hotspot for guests who can’t join VPN.
Zoe: Hotseat rule idea: 3 lives per player, loser refills drinks. :trophy:
Jonah: @Maya can you bring a USB-C -> HDMI adapter for the Switch? My dock cover is missing.
Maya: Yup I have one. Also thinking of a controller lending table by the door.
Sam: I can leave 2 wired controllers and a spare USB stick (16GB) for save transfers.
Priya: Suggestion: small signup list here so we know who brings what. Like: Name - console/PC - bringables.
Maya: Ok, signup thread:
Maya: Maya - projector + TV + will order pizza
Maya: Jonah - Switch + dock
Maya: Sam - 8-port switch + 2 controllers + spare USB stick
Maya: Priya - Cat6 + router tweaks + extra cables
Maya: Zoe - Steam game swaps (Portal 2, Into The Breach)
Jonah: Perfect. Any time for arrivals? 17:00 sound good?
Priya: 17:00 works. I'll come a bit early to set up the switch.
Zoe: Can someone bring a power strip with surge protection? Preferably 3m cable.
Sam: I have a couple of power strips I can bring.
Maya: One more thing — please don't post account passwords or trade login creds in this channel. If you want to do Steam Family Share coordination DM each other.
Zoe: Good call. See you Sat! :party_parrot:
Jonah: Excited. Thanks Maya for organizing! :rocket:
